Description: Colossal Cave Adventure game Explore Colossal Cave, where others have found fortunes in treasure and gold, though it is rumored that some who enter are never seen again. . Colossal Cave Adventure (originally named “ADVENT” or “Adventure”) is the seminal text adventure game, written by Will Crowther and Don Woods. . This is a re-implementation of the “350-point” version, using the same game content from the PDP-10 source code of the late 1970s. . It uses the original text exactly, and emits responses slow enough to read as the contemporary terminal interfaces did.
